description: Source-backed evidence package contract for local Graph-RAG query outputs. Claims cite bounded source chunks; graph facts and cited files remain authoritative.

source_boundary.text_source_of_truth: cited repository files and line ranges
source_boundary.writes_runtime_outputs_to: tmp/graph-rag only when --write or --out is passed

uncertainties.meaning: Known limits of the deterministic retrieval or optional local context adapter; absence of uncertainty is invalid.

budget_report.purpose: Expose the context budget used before handing compact evidence to the main model.

validation_rules.rule: Every claim must have path, lineStart, lineEnd, chunkId and hash.
confidence must be one of high, medium or low.
Each claim and the package must carry at least one uncertainty marker.
Package output must include the context budget report.
